data.name: Out for Blood
data.description: When a creature takes extra damage from the hate-monger's painful stare, it also takes 1 point of bleed damage (or 1 point of bleed damage per 1d6 points of damage dealt by the painful stare if the hate- monger damages the target himself). This bleed damage does not stack with itself or other sources of bleed damage.
